title: No coding background, built an online co-op game in UE5 C++ with AI writing the code
author: ForgePointGames
selftext:
I'm a solo dev with no programming background. For Raccoon Bistro, a chaotic online co-op cooking game for 1–4 players, the AI writes all the C++ (multiplayer, Steam lobbies, customers, cooking systems) and I design, test and fix things in Blueprints.

The biggest lesson: one small task at a time, and test it before moving on. The AI is great at networking code but sometimes guesses wrong about UE5, so testing every step is a must.

Free demo coming soon on Steam:  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5519310/Raccoon\_Bistro/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5519310/Raccoon_Bistro/)
